Huff, huff...Finally we're here~.
Guys, it's here! That's the "Beastmaster" Scroll,\nthe secret sorcery of Hagakure!
What? Beastmaster? What the hey is that?
A terrifying technique for controlling powerful,\ngigantic animals is written in it!
Really?! You can master such a powerful technique\njust by reading the scroll?
Yes! No training or effort is needed at all!\nAnyone can use it as long as they have the\nscroll!
It sounds kinda cheap, but hey, who doesn't love\nan easy shortcut?
I'll show it to you!
What? You can use it already?
Wait a sec, what's the gigantic animal you're\ngonna control though? It's not gonna be a giant\ntoad or a huge snake, right?
And please don't suddenly summon a giant slug,\nokay? Or I'll scream and run away!
From salad greens, to vanilla beans...\nLet the magic cause no harm...
Haaah!
Wow!!\nWhy does it have to be a giant flying squirrel,\nthough?!
Flying squirrels sometimes sip the nectar of\nsakura and there are many sakura trees in Leafy\nSakura Village, so maybe that's why.
Well, it might be stronger than it looks since it\ncan glide.
Yes! With the legendary Sakura Storm sword in the\npaw of this giant flying squirrel, I'll defeat\nCaylass!
Are you sure you wanna go with a strategy that\nrelies on a flying squirrel? Well, we shouldn't be\nsticking our noses into your business, though.
It looks like there aren't any other treasures\nhere. Honestly, I'm kinda disappointed. I guess we\nshould just head back for now...?
What? It seems like you've got something to say.
A huge flying squirrel is strong.
What bothers Caylass is...
I see! Caylass didn't wanna fight Princess Nanaka\nbecause she was weak!
If this huge flying squirrel turns out to be\nstrong, it might actually make him wanna fight for\nreal!
You're right! The fact that Princess Nanaka was\nweak bothers him, and that's why he didn't wanna\nfight her!
But if Princess Nanaka becomes powerful with the\npower of the huge flying squirrel, he might\nactually be glad to fight her!
Hehe, are you hungry? I'll make you some food\nlater. Be a good kid and hold it for now.
Don't you think we should have a word with Caylass\nbefore this turns into a really nasty fight?
Ahem, Princess Nanaka, we'll go to Caylass first\nto keep an eye on him and make sure he doesn't\nrun away from the duel!
Thank you!\nI'll go back to Leafy Sakura Village to get things\nready first, then head over!
I really appreciate your help!\nI'll prepare a proper reward for you, so please\nwait for it!
Hahaha, it better be good!\nAlright then, see you later~!
Well, let's hurry back to Caylass!
